snippet.title: Tiny Ramen Shop - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Tiny Ramen Shop on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4330750/Tiny_Ramen_Shop/

Run your own Tiny Ramen Shop! It's tiny, yes, but customers are already lining up to try your delicious ramen. Prepare food, stock your warehouse with fresh ingredients, upgrade and decorate your establishment. Hungry customers are waiting for their favorite ramen chef!

Discord - https://discord.gg/KNrsHd4z2r
